notes.title: 0.5.9.3 - Blackout? What blackout?
notes.content:
Distraught, those within the confines of the arcade's walls stood motionless and quiet in the darkness as the last of the machines flickered into darkness. What would they do? What [i]could[/i] they do? Sadly, they could do nothing but stand there waiting for the power to come back on; for someone to realize the lights had gone out. Don't they ever look at their own building!? They thought - they screamed. They all screamed like banshees in the darkness, raging at the darkness before them. Yet there was no response... just frustrating silence. 

But alas! There is light where there was none! The place flickered back to life as the hum and snap of the transformers and relays became activated. Thank goodness! Still there was silence. Perhaps it was the silence of embarrassment or shame? No, it was neither. Perhaps it was that the owner of the arcade forgot to double-check the arcade before taking a hiatus thinking all was well. And then no one reached out to say, "Hey, dumbass! You fucked up your last update, go fix it!!!" Ah, but then one cannot (and is not) laying blame on anyone but oneself. It was my bad and I am a total idiot for not noticing such an epic FUBAR. Please forgive me.

[*]Reimplemented flipper tuner option and refined it. This is used to control flip speed (up), as a tweak for flipper english, and can be thought of as a flip speed modifier. Choosing an appropriate setting will allow players to use flipper tap english to control the full flip extent of the flipper just as can be done with real flippers, allowing for shorter flipper strokes. [*]Connected kicker solenoid component to logic so it will kick only when lit (similar to SHIELD in Firepower)

[*]Fixed blank playfield texture roughness and normal

[*]Set singular concurrency for user audio files auditioned from Cabinet Panel
[/list]
